title: review follow-ups of PR #37637: the runtime draft bar keeps a stale token after "reload", publishItem pin docs
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (nit N6 of #37387's review, carried on card #37440 and not taken by PR #37637; contract review record 7198547999 on PR #37637, nits N1 and N2, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37637 (Fixes #37440) pins every draft-then-publish Save to its own draft receipt. Merging it closes #37440, which is the only card that recorded these items:

- [ ] **The runtime draft bar keeps the old token after "reload"** (N6 from #37387's review). After a refused Save is resolved with "reload" in `DraftConflictDialog`, the runtime draft bar (`RuntimeDraftBar` / `ViewConfigPanel`) still holds the token from before the reload. Its Publish then fails closed until the panel is reopened. Expected: the reload hands the bar the reloaded draft's version.
- [ ] **`parentVersion` JSDoc** (N1): the `draftVersion` JSDoc on `client.meta.publishItem` says an empty string pins nothing; the `parentVersion` JSDoc does not, though `''` is treated the same.
- [ ] **SDK page** (N2): the `publishItem` example in `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` shows only `message`; it does not show the two pins.

Category ①: a user-visible Publish that fails until the panel is reopened, plus doc gaps on a shipped client method.
Priority: p3. The Publish fails closed (nothing wrong goes live), and reopening the panel recovers it.
Business reason: an administrator who resolves a draft conflict by reloading, then clicks Publish in the draft bar, sees the publish refused for no visible reason.
Reader: the ux lane that next touches the metadata-admin draft bar (seat 2, s2-ux-S).
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37637"` and `RuntimeDraftBar reload token`: 0 hits.
Related: #37440, PR #37637, #37387, #36350.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (review of #37387) · evidence: read → p3
